examples.rationale: Captions snap to the word-level startMs, sit in the lower-third safe band, and chunk to 1-3 words punching with the voice.
Short readable windows held long enough to land, clear of the speaker's face and the platform UI chrome.
A single caption packs fourteen words into one window — a wall of text no viewer reads in the time it is on screen.
Captions fire roughly 700ms after the words are spoken — the track visibly desyncs from the voice.
The caption box sits over the speaker's face the whole clip, blocking the one thing the viewer needs to see.
